verdict.rationale: Runloop docs explicitly support long-running sessions: suspend/resume to pause and later resume a devbox exactly where it left off, idle/shutdown controls, persistent event streams (Axons) for suspend-on-idle/wake-on-demand/state recovery, and snapshotting for state persistence across sessions — all aimed at long agent workflows spanning hours/days. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence (e.g., a third-party report) confirming multi-day session stability at scale, and no explicit stated max session duration/SLA.
